summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting the local-market placement of senior, dematerialized, bearer bonds (Series GA, registered under CMF No. 11/2022) for CLF 250,000 (approx. UF 250,000) due May 1, 2034, at an average rate of 3.03%. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or strategic review is involved. The filing merely satisfies foreign private issuer reporting obligations under Rule 13a-16. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. Watch for no risk-arb angle as this is an ordinary financing event.
